verdict.rationale: Whether a CRM's source is available under an open license is a fair question for this kind of product, since open-source CRMs exist, so the axis applies. Nothing in the evidence pack shows Dynamics 365 Sales source code published under an open license. The Web API and Power Apps customization are extensibility features, not source availability, so they earn no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can read the product's source under an open license
